note: Unincorporated Bacon County has no zoning per the 2017 joint comprehensive plan (SGRC). City of Alma has a zoning ordinance (Municode Chapter 94) and planning commission, but its zoning districts are not published as any queryable GIS service; city staff direct GIS/zoning map requests to Code Enforcement by phone. No ArcGIS Hub/Online zoning layer for Bacon County or Alma was found in searches. Bacon County GIS offers only parcel viewers (qPublic/Schneider), which carry no zoning districts.
